sections.title: Law of Planning and Urban Development
sections.description: The central focus will be on selected aspects of the field of the law of planning and development, a field that embraces a range of legal doctrines that are particularly relevant to cities and suburbs. We will study the principles that govern the regulation of land use and management of urban growth (through land use controls and other techniques for regulating new development)and, to a limited extent, environmental planning laws.
